# polaris_catalog (Data Source)

Reads metadata of an existing Apache Polaris catalog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "polaris_catalog" "existing" {
  name = "analytics_catalog"
}

output "catalog_location" {
  value = data.polaris_catalog.existing.default_base_location
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the catalog to query.

### Read-Only

- `create_timestamp` (Number) Creation epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `default_base_location` (String) Default base location configured for the catalog.
- `entity_version` (Number) Current entity version counter.
- `last_update_timestamp` (Number) Last update epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `properties` (Map of String) Catalog metadata key-value properties.
- `type` (String) The catalog type (`INTERNAL` or `EXTERNAL`).
